subject: Passing variables during startup of shiny app

messages.author: 85435c7e2689700c
messages.subject: Passing variables during startup of shiny app
parts:
Hi

I'm developing an app that, depending on whether it should run locally or on a server, should behave slightly different. Is it possible to somehow specify variables such as 'local=TRUE' during a runApp() call? Or is there another way that allows the user to specify variables in the global environment on the server?

If not consider this a feature request.

best

Thomas

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Passing variables during startup of shiny app
parts:
If you mean whether the app is running locally or in a Shiny Server
instance, you can find out this way:

isServer <- nzchar(Sys.getenv("SHINY_PORT"))
